ideas.title: Investigation into Evidence Withholding
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of evidence withholding in the Minnesota shootings investigation and other cases
questions: Who is responsible for withholding evidence?
ideas.insight: This story idea has the potential to uncover a large-scale cover-up or obstruction of justice. By following the evidence and investigating the withholding of evidence, we may be able to shed light on a systemic issue that has far-reaching implications.
